page.content:
Prodigy princess of blue fire and lightning.

How Azula connects

  • Faction: Fire Nation — Azula is a princess of the Fire Nation.
  • Faction: The Gaang — Azula hunts the Gaang through the Earth Kingdom.
  • Location: Ba Sing Se — Azula's coup takes Ba Sing Se from the inside.

What is Azula?

Azula is Ozai's favored child, a precise firebender who takes Ba Sing Se, hunts the Gaang with Mai and Ty Lee, and cracks under the crown.

Key threads lead to Fire Nation, The Gaang and Ba Sing Se.
